_note: Real lunar orbiters for the 'your design most resembles...' comparison. Only figures copied from a cited NASA source are stored. Entries that say 'confirm' must be checked against the NASA PDF before the demo.

real_missions.name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO)

launch_mass_kg.source: NASA LRO/LCROSS Press Kit, June 2009 (archived copy: https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/web/20090922191046/http:/lro.gsfc.nasa.gov/images/LRO_LCROSS_presskit.pdf). Figures read from Spaceflight Now's reproduction of the press kit text (https://spaceflightnow.com/atlas/av020/090610lro.html) because the PDF itself could not be opened; confirm against the PDF page before the demo. Launch mass 1,916 kg.

dry_mass_kg.source: NASA LRO/LCROSS Press Kit, June 2009 (archived copy: https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/web/20090922191046/http:/lro.gsfc.nasa.gov/images/LRO_LCROSS_presskit.pdf). Figures read from Spaceflight Now's reproduction of the press kit text (https://spaceflightnow.com/atlas/av020/090610lro.html) because the PDF itself could not be opened; confirm against the PDF page before the demo. Dry mass 1,018 kg.

payload_mass_kg.source: Not in the NASA text I could open. 92.6 kg is from the Wikipedia infobox; replace with the sum of the press-kit instrument masses or delete before the demo.

orbit.value: Polar, about 50 km altitude (base mission); later 30 x 216 km
orbit.source: NASA NSSDCA LRO record and NAIF LRO SPICE catalog (insthost.cat): base mission 50 +/- 20 km, 30 x 216 km low-maintenance orbit for commissioning and extended mission.

primary_lifetime_months.source: NASA NSSDCA LRO record: one-year base mission in a polar orbit.

real_missions.instruments_source: NASA LRO/LCROSS Press Kit, June 2009 lists LROC, LOLA, LEND, LAMP, Diviner, CRaTER and Mini-RF (instrument list also in NASA-sourced pages; confirm names in the PDF).

mission_orbit_alt_km.source: NAIF LRO SPICE catalog (insthost.cat): base mission altitude 50 +/- 20 km. https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/pds/data/lro-l-spice-6-v1.0/lrosp_1000/catalog/insthost.cat
